Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 161: Sandwiched

Li Luo didn't know what Ying Zhicheng had discussed with Yuan Wanqing in the dressing room earlier and thought he had already bluffed his way through.

After returning to the dressing room, he relaxed slightly and let out a sigh of relief as he sat down beside Yan Zhusheng.

"You seem a little nervous." Yan Zhusheng glanced at Li Luo's expression. "Are you okay?"

"Ahem, I'm fine." Li Luo wasn't nervous because of the upcoming interview; after all, he had just gone to the interview room to coordinate with the host.

He was purely startled by Ying Zhicheng's sudden appearance.

But Yan Zhusheng didn't know this and thought Li Luo was nervous because of the interview. So she took out her Bluetooth earbuds from her pocket and placed one into Li Luo's ear.

"Let's listen to some music," Yan Zhusheng said. "I listen to music when I'm nervous."

"Okay." Li Luo didn't refuse Yan Zhusheng's kind gesture and shared the earbuds with her to listen to music.

Qian Zhou, who was sitting on Li Luo's other side, watched this young couple's interaction, speechless and unsure what to say.

Are high school students these days all so open?

It wasn't about the matter of high school students dating.

Qian Zhou wasn't some old-fashioned person. Back when he was in high school, in a small, remote county town, things like fights and abortions weren't uncommon.

But to be in a proper relationship and so openly display affection in front of a parent, this was the first damn time Qian Zhou had ever seen it.

It felt like Yuan Wanqing had tacitly approved, or had she just not noticed?

Qian Zhou rubbed his arms, which were covered in goosebumps, and wept silently in his heart.

He had a crush on a girl when he was in high school. He confessed on graduation day and was rejected.

Heartbroken, he went far away to Changning City for university. During that time, apart from studying, he just read webnovels. In a big metropolis like Changning City, the girls were all so youthful and beautiful.

As a boy from a small county town, he never dared to have any improper thoughts about anyone.

He graduated in a daze and, relying on his extensive reading of webnovels, tried hard in interviews and successfully joined Wenyue Group as a new editor.

But he was actually still within his one-year observation period.

If he couldn't successfully mentor a new author and his performance didn't meet the standards after a year, it was very likely he would be "optimized."

So, he was very excited that a Chongran had appeared this time.

To seize this opportunity for a potential bestseller, he had even taken the high-speed rail directly from Changning City to accompany him.

Otherwise, under normal circumstances, the process wouldn't require an editor to come in person.

This was him being overly concerned.

But who would have known that after coming here, he would run into such a normie.

This author with the pen name Chongran was only 16 years old, attending a provincial key high school in Yuhang City, dating a school beauty-level girl, writing a bestselling webnovel that earned tens of thousands a month, and also writing songs for a returning female singer.

What kind of protagonist template was this?

Qian Zhou looked at Li Luo with a resentful expression, suddenly feeling that coming to Yuhang City to see him was a complete mistake.

It was just too demoralizing.

"What's wrong, Editor?" Li Luo, listening to music, turned his head and saw Qian Zhou's woeful little gaze, momentarily stunned. "Why do you look so sad?"

"Heh, hehe... I just suddenly feel like life is bleak," Qian Zhou said feebly, forcing a smile.

"How could that be?" Li Luo patted his shoulder. "I think you have the makings of a chief editor. You might even become the editor-in-chief in the future."

"Well, thank you very much for that." Qian Zhou gave a helpless smile. He hadn't even secured his job yet, how could he dare to dream of the chief editor position.

But Li Luo knew that this was a foregone conclusion from his previous life.

Now, with the boost from Li Luo's achievements in this life, as long as Qian Zhou didn't screw things up himself, he should be able to reach the chief editor position again.

"Teacher Chongran, are you sure you don't want me to do your makeup?" After finishing Yuan Wanqing's styling, the makeup artist smiled at Li Luo and teased the young boy, "I'm very good at doing makeup for guys."

"No, no." Li Luo waved his hand in refusal. "I won't be on camera later, so let's not waste time."

He had already arranged with Qian Zhou and the host that although he would participate in the interview, they would use emojis or something similar in post-production to cover his face.

This way, his identity wouldn't be exposed.

"Teacher Yuan, it's almost two in the afternoon." Just then, a staff member pushed the door open and said to Yuan Wanqing, "Are you ready?"

Yuan Wanqing looked at the vanity mirror in front of her. The makeup artist beside her gave her an OK gesture, so Yuan Wanqing nodded and said, "Yes, I'm ready. We can start anytime."

"Alright, then please, Teacher Yuan and Teacher Chongran, proceed to the interview room to prepare. We'll start the interview shortly."

The interview with Wenyue Group was very simple.

After all, they weren't really here to interview Yuan Wanqing, but for the gimmick of a collaboration between a popular singer and a webnovel author.

Therefore, after a simple interview and introduction of the two interviewees' basic information, the host focused on a series of questions centered around the song "Annual Rings" and the book "I'm Really Not a Star."

About an hour later, the interview concluded successfully.

Sitting in the interview room, having spoken for so long in front of a camera for the first time, Li Luo let out a long sigh, feeling like sweat was about to bead on his forehead.

Yuan Wanqing was already used to this. After completing the interview, she stretched her back. Her assistant had already moved closer and whispered, "Sister Yuan, you have an event to attend at four in the afternoon."

"Yes, I know." Yuan Wanqing nodded. After returning to the dressing room with Li Luo, she said to Yan Zhusheng, "Mom has things to do this afternoon. Are you two planning to have dinner here at the company cafeteria, or are you going home?"

"I'm going to Li Luo's house for dinner," Yan Zhusheng said immediately. "I've already made plans with Xixi and the others."

"Oh, then you two go ahead," Yuan Wanqing said with a smile. "Be safe on the way."

"Mhm." Yan Zhusheng nodded happily and walked out of the Huayue Film and Television company building with Li Luo.

Qian Zhou followed beside them, feeling like his presence was completely out of place with the two.

Once they were out the company's main entrance, he waved his hand and said, "Since the interview has successfully concluded, I'll head back to Changning City first."

"You're not staying a bit longer?" Li Luo politely tried to make him stay. "You can come to my place for a meal before you go."

"No, no, I've booked the 4:30 PM high-speed rail back," Qian Zhou politely declined. "I'll come freeload a meal from you next time, or if you come to Changning City to hang out, you can look me up. I'll give you a tour of our company."

"No problem." Li Luo smiled and made an OK gesture. After hailing a taxi by the roadside, he and Yan Zhusheng got in.

After saying goodbye to Qian Zhou outside the car, the taxi headed towards Bihai Lanting in Yinjiang District. It took about half an hour to reach the entrance of the residential complex.

"At lunch, you mentioned an album single to Mom. What exactly did you have in mind?" Yan Zhusheng asked curiously.

"It's hard to say for now." Li Luo shook his head and chuckled. "It was just a spur-of-the-moment idea."

"Since the effect of a crossover collaboration is so good."

"What if for every original song I write in the novel, Auntie Yuan releases a new song in reality as a tie-in."

"What do you think the effect would be like?"

Yan Zhusheng imagined it for a moment, then nodded and said, "That sounds very interesting."

"Yes, very interesting," Li Luo said. "But if it happens too often, the audience might not get aesthetic fatigue. That's why I said it's hard to predict the effect. We'll have to discuss it more later."

The two chatted idly all the way and soon arrived at the door of 1502.

Li Luo took out his keys and pushed the door open, only to see Xu Youyu lying on her stomach on the living room sofa, her two long legs crossed in the air, licking a mini pudding popsicle while looking at her phone.

"Huh?" Xu Youyu heard the noise at the door, looked up, and said in surprise, "You're back so early?"

"Yeah." Yan Zhusheng nodded and honestly began, "The interview..."

"We came back right after the recording session," Li Luo discreetly tugged on Yan Zhusheng's arm, quickly interrupting her spell-casting. He took a pair of slippers from the cabinet and tossed them to her. "Change your shoes."

Yan Zhusheng blinked, only then realizing she had almost let it slip. She immediately shut her mouth and obediently changed her shoes.

"Xixi's class doesn't end until four." Xu Youyu held out the wooden stick of the finished pudding popsicle towards Li Luo as he walked into the living room. "We haven't bought groceries yet."

"Then let's go buy them together later." Li Luo took the stick and threw it into the nearby trash can, subconsciously glancing at the abyss being pressed down upon by Xu Youyu.

The next second, Xu Youyu tilted her head, and her teasing, smiling eyes met his gaze instantly.

Li Luo's mouth twitched, and he immediately forced his gaze away.

"We have some time now, then." Xu Youyu flipped over, got off the sofa, and padded barefoot into the piano room. She brought out the guitar that Ying Chanxi had brought from her home and handed it to Li Luo. "Didn't you write a new song? I want to hear it."

"Alright."

As the price for losing their little eye game again, Li Luo took the guitar and sat down on the sofa, then looked at Yan Zhusheng. "You sing or I sing."

"You sing." Yan Zhusheng sat down next to him. "I want to hear it too."

"Hurry up and sing. Zhusheng is a guest, how can you have the nerve to ask her to display her talents?" Xu Youyu sat on Li Luo's other side, crossing her legs on the sofa, her knee nudging against Li Luo.

"I know, I know. You two sit properly, don't crowd me." Li Luo held the guitar in his lap, composed himself for a moment, then lightly strummed the strings.

"When I was curiously tapping on the black and white keys"

"When I was hiding in my room, performing with ecstatic abandon"

Li Luo hummed the new song.

Xu Youyu and Yan Zhusheng sat on either side of him, one swaying her body in enjoyment, the other closing her eyes and listening quietly.

Meanwhile, Ying Chanxi was in the competition class classroom at First Affiliated High, diligently solving one math competition problem after another.

She was completely unaware of what was happening at home.

(End of this chapter)

June Summary, July Plea for Tickets

Rekindling the Verdant Years June Summary, July Plea for Tickets

1. Report on performance and bonus chapters

When the book went on sale on June 1st, the initial subscription was 2,400.

The current average subscription is over 3,900, let's round it up to 4,000.

According to what I said in the launch announcement at the beginning of the month, I need to release 16 bonus chapters.

Then there are the Alliance Lords. This book has received donations from 7 Alliance Lords and 1 Silver Alliance Lord, so I need to release 17 bonus chapters for that.

The final monthly ticket total for June was 3,700+. Calculated at one bonus chapter per 500 tickets, that's 7 bonus chapters.

So in total, that's exactly 40 bonus chapters.

The total word count for June was 260,000 words, which is 140,000 more than the guaranteed base of 120,000 words.

Calculated at 2,000 words per chapter, that means I've already released 70 bonus chapters in June.

That's 30 more chapters than what was required.

So now you guys technically owe me 30 bonus chapters (doge face)

I will post a screenshot of the word count in a subsequent bonus chapter for everyone to check.

——————————

2. Some thoughts on this book

The general framework of this book, having written this far, should be apparent to everyone.

Whether it's the three female leads themselves, or their parents, like Ying Zhicheng, Yuan Wanqing, or Xu Rongsheng, they are all more or less linked to the protagonist's career storyline and will have some connection.

And in their school life, the three female leads each have their own points of focus.

It's just that because they are in the same class and are deskmates, Yan Zhusheng's presence is currently stronger.

But everything exists in a state of dynamic balance and development.

I hope everyone can give this book enough time to slowly reveal an exciting and interesting high school life.

In addition, the university arc will also be covered, please don't worry about that. After all, I set Qianjiang University next to First Affiliated High precisely to lay the groundwork and prepare for it.

Therefore, my goal for this book is to write at least two million words, to push past my previous limits.

I hope that by then, all of you will still be here, accompanying me, and accompanying the lovely girls in the book, to walk together to the very end.

By the way, congratulations to the three female leads for having their heart counts in the character section surpass the male lead's. This is great news.

This can also be seen as an affirmation of my character creation.

Especially at the beginning, when everyone really liked Xixi, I was still very nervous when Xu Youyu and Yan Zhusheng first appeared.

But later, as Yan Zhusheng's popularity quickly rose, my anxious heart could finally rest for a while.

As for the senpai, she will have her own main stage waiting for her to perform. Everyone, please look forward to it~

——————————

3. Future bonus chapter plans for this book

Following the old rules from the launch announcement.

The current average subscription is 4,000. For July, for every 100-point increase in average subscriptions, there will be one bonus chapter.

For every new Alliance Lord, there will be one bonus chapter.

As for monthly tickets, I feel like one bonus chapter per 500 tickets might be overestimating myself, so for July, let's go with one bonus chapter per 200 tickets.

The three bonus chapter methods above will all take effect in July.

As for the 30 surplus bonus chapters from June, let's just reset them to zero. They won't be carried over into July's bonus chapters.

Let's start from scratch and recalculate.

I hope everyone can give me your support!

Please cast your precious monthly tickets~

Thank you so much!

That is all.

Mizhi Ji bows in gratitude~
